content: No single industry-standard cancellation policy for Thai ferry/speedboat operators; common pattern is tiered refund by notice window (e.g. full refund 48h+, partial or none inside 48h; some operators offer 7-day 80% tier); some OTAs like Klook disallow cancellation once confirmed; refund processing commonly 30-45 business days; optional paid cancellation insurance is a common upsell.
